$comment: Shops whose whole catalogue is read by CatalogService (rows in catalog_offers, served by /feed/catalog — never in deals). One entry per shop, no code. A source is read only when `verified` (its probe passed: POST /admin/catalog/<id>/probe) AND `enabled`. `include`/`exclude` are regexes on the sitemap's URLs, `titleMustMatch`/`titleExclude` on the product's name. `perRun` pages per pass (max 400), `pauseSeconds` between requests (min 1), `everyHours` before a page is read again. Passes run at `activeHours` (Paris), every shop side by side at its own pace, so that every price is read again within `everyHours`. Children's watches are left out (title or « Genre » line). `updated` (date): the copy shipped in the code is used unless the one under appDir() carries a later date.
